troubleshoot: If the server reports an expired session, request access again using your own checkout email. Do not send a browser token or storage dump to support. Signing out does not cancel an order or erase the merchant's records.

title: Find customer bills separately from platform invoices
intro: Bills & Payments separates documents you issue to customers from documents issued to you by the platform. Keeping the issuer clear prevents incorrect forwarding and bookkeeping.
steps: Open Settings, then Bills & Payments.
Choose the relevant customer-bill or platform-payment list.
Check the document number, buyer and amount before opening an entry.
Refresh if you expect a recently generated document.
success: You can identify whose document you are reading before downloading or sharing it.
troubleshoot: The inspected screen requests the first 30 records for each list. An absent older document is not proof it never existed. Locate its order or ask support with the document reference; do not generate a new bill just to make it appear here.

title: Inspect a bill before choosing Save or Share
intro: The bill-preview screen loads the PDF for inspection. Opening it is different from deliberately saving or sharing a permanent copy.
steps: Open the bill from the document list.
Wait for the preview and check its document number.
Read the customer and amount before using Save / Share.
Choose the intended device destination or recipient, or close the preview without sharing.
success: The viewed document matches the record you intended to distribute. Saving reuses the previewed file rather than creating a new bill.
troubleshoot: If the preview cannot load, resolve the connection or document error first. Do not forward a blank or unrelated file. On a shared device, remember that a downloaded PDF can remain outside the app even after you sign out.

title: Investigate an empty bill list before assuming records were deleted
intro: The current list screen can display empty results after a loading failure. An empty screen is therefore not enough evidence that no bills exist.
steps: Check the connection and refresh Bills & Payments.
Verify whether you selected customer bills or platform-issued documents.
Open a known order and inspect its Bill section.
Record the document reference and time if the list still omits a document you can identify.
success: You can distinguish a missing list result from a genuinely ungenerated bill.
troubleshoot: Do not delete or recreate orders to repair a list problem. The current list fetch is bounded, so older documents may need another lookup route. Escalate with a redacted reference rather than sending an entire customer invoice publicly.

title: Find the billing GST settings without relying on an old profile field
intro: GST & Tax is a separate Settings screen. A legacy GST value on a profile is not necessarily the billing setting used by the current document workflow.
steps: Open Settings and choose GST & Tax.
Read the current GSTIN and any warning about an older profile value.
Compare the displayed setting with your verified business records.
Only edit it when you know the correct information and have authority to change billing configuration.
success: You have identified the billing-specific setting rather than assuming a profile entry controls invoices.
troubleshoot: This article explains the screen, not whether you must register or which tax treatment applies. Obtain appropriate professional guidance for those decisions. Do not enter a made-up GSTIN to change the document label or remove an empty state.

title: Understand the confirmation before saving GST settings
intro: Saving tax configuration requires an explicit acknowledgement. Read it as a consequential billing change, not a routine screen-dismissal step.
steps: Open GST & Tax and check the existing values.
Make only the verified change you intend.
Choose Save and read Confirm your GST settings.
Use I understand, apply only if the change is correct; otherwise cancel and review it.
success: The app confirms that the settings were updated and reflects the saved values. If nothing changed, it says they are already up to date.
troubleshoot: Do not interpret this confirmation as tax advice or legal validation of your business circumstances. If saving fails, reopen the screen before retrying. Retain your own evidence for why the billing setting was chosen.

title: Distinguish the billing default from a product-specific tax setting
intro: The GST & Tax screen describes its default rate as applying to products without their own HSN or rate. That makes the default and product fields different inputs.
steps: Read the current default setting in GST & Tax.
Check whether the product in question already has its own HSN or rate.
Use verified classification information rather than choosing a convenient number.
Review the resulting document before sharing it with a customer.
success: You know which configuration needs investigation when a bill's tax treatment appears unexpected.
troubleshoot: This guide does not prescribe a rate or classify goods. Do not assume changing the default rewrites previously issued documents or overrides every product. Ask a qualified adviser about classification and report an application discrepancy with a redacted document reference.

title: Recover from a failed PDF save without duplicating the bill
intro: A failed download can be a device or connection problem while the bill itself still exists. Keep generation and file-saving steps separate.
steps: Check that the existing document number remains visible.
Retry opening its preview or download after restoring the connection.
Check available device storage and the destination shown by the app.
Open the saved file before forwarding it.
success: The same existing document becomes readable on the device. No replacement order or second bill is needed merely to repeat a file download.
troubleshoot: If the problem persists, report the document number, platform, app version and redacted error. Do not include complete customer addresses, banking details or the entire PDF unless an authorised private support process specifically needs it.

title: Send a useful support report without exposing customer or payment secrets
intro: A precise report helps distinguish a screen problem from a saved-state problem. Collect the smallest evidence that demonstrates the issue.
steps: Write the screen name, action, actual result and expected result.
Include the time, app version and relevant product, order or document reference.
Redact customer contact details, full addresses and sensitive financial information from screenshots.
Use the official support route and say whether a retry, refresh or state-changing action has already occurred.
success: Support receives a reproducible description without needing your password, OTP or complete account export.
troubleshoot: Never share secret keys, session tokens, bank credentials or UPI PINs. For an uncertain order, stock or payment update, pause repeated submissions and explain that the outcome is unknown. Do not let a troubleshooting step silently become a second business transaction.
